prompt: Fees need to know the region. Change `FeeRule.fee(self, subtotal)` in billing/fees.py to `fee(self, subtotal, region)`, with `region` required, and give every subclass that overrides `fee` the same signature. `PercentFee`, and any fee rule built on it, charges no fee when the region is "DE"; every other rule ignores the region. Every caller must pass the region it is working with. The test suite must pass when you are done.
why: A signature change with an override in another package (payroll.fees.CappedFee builds on PercentFee and calls super().fee), and callers in three modules across two packages, one through a typed attribute (`self.rule`).
